headline: End of an era: Lionel Messi retires from Argentina national team
summary: The football legend retires after 20 years of service, leaving a three-page farewell message for his teammates and fans.
details: Argentine superstar Lionel Messi has officially decided to retire from the national team, sparking emotional reactions from across the football world.
Messi left a heartfelt three-page farewell message, reflecting on his 20-year journey with the 'Albiceleste' and expressing gratitude to his family, coaches, and teammates.
Teammate Angel Di Maria, belirtti that it is hard to read that Messi will no longer wear the sky blue and white jersey, noting that he was born in the right century to witness Messi's greatness.
Tributes have poured in from across the globe, with fans and colleagues describing him as the 'greatest of all time' and an inspiration to millions who redefined the beautiful game.
The football community, including sports fans in Bangladesh, has been deeply moved by the announcement, as Messi's international career has left an eternal mark on the football world.
caption:
20 years, a golden legacy. Lionel Messi says goodbye to the Argentina national team.

Argentine superstar Lionel Messi has officially decided to retire from the national team, sparking emotional reactions from across the football world.

Messi left a heartfelt three-page farewell message, reflecting on his 20-year journey with the 'Albiceleste' and expressing gratitude to his family, coaches, and teammates.

Teammate Angel Di Maria, belirtti that it is hard to read that Messi will no longer wear the sky blue and white jersey, noting that he was born in the right century to witness Messi's greatness.

Tributes have poured in from across the globe, with fans and colleagues describing him as the 'greatest of all time' and an inspiration to millions who redefined the beautiful game.

The football community, including sports fans in Bangladesh, has been deeply moved by the announcement, as Messi's international career has left an eternal mark on the football world.

headline: Over 1,000 dead in Nepal-China floods
summary: At least 1,003 people have died in devastating floods on the China-Nepal border, with over 4,400 people still missing across both nations.
details: Devastating floods on the China-Nepal border have killed at least 1,003 people, according to disaster authorities. Nepal has reported 987 deaths, while Chinese state media confirmed 16 deaths in Tibet.
The scale of the disaster is immense, with 4,462 people still missing, including 546 in China and 3,916 in Nepal.

The missing include hundreds of foreigners from over 30 nationalities. This includes 275 Indian citizens and 128 people of Indian origin, and 85 US citizens, as well as citizens of Ukraine, Malaysia, Australia, and the British.
Rescue efforts have entered their seventh day, as teams race to reach those believed to be trapped in tunnels.
In India, authorities in Uttar Pradesh state have recovered 17 bodies from rivers flowing from Nepal, believed to be flood victims, who are currently being identified.
Nepal's Prime Minister has called for effective international climate action following this Himalayan disaster.
caption:
Over 1,000 people dead and 4,400 missing. A Himalayan disaster of catastrophic proportions.

Devastating floods on the China-Nepal border have killed at least 1,003 people, according to disaster authorities. Nepal has reported 987 deaths, while Chinese state media confirmed 16 deaths in Tibet.

The scale of the disaster is immense, with 4,462 people still missing, including 546 in China and 3,916 in Nepal.

The missing include hundreds of foreigners from over 30 nationalities. This includes 275 Indian citizens and 128 people of Indian origin, and 85 US citizens, as well as citizens of Ukraine, Malaysia, Australia, and the British.

Rescue efforts have entered their seventh day, as teams race to reach those believed to be trapped in tunnels.

In India, authorities in Uttar Pradesh state have recovered 17 bodies from rivers flowing from Nepal, believed to be flood victims, who are currently being identified.

Nepal's Prime Minister has called for effective international climate action following this Himalayan disaster.
